_comment: Fair URM baseline for the cognitive-map rule synapse, matched to runs/cmap_lin_big (2026-10-21): URM blocks (lt/urm_vendor via toy_g/urm_harness.py; ConvSwiGLU -> SwiGLU, no ACT) on data/miniarc_v104.npz (Mini-ARC, 149 tasks, transductive, 104 versions per task = 8 D4 x 13 colour permutations; test = identity version, single prediction, exact match). Matched: parameters (hidden 352, 8 heads: 1,586,114 vs 1,564,795), 32 blocks per query of which only the last 4 get gradients (URM truncated backprop: H_cycles 8 x L_cycles 4; ours: 16 recurrent steps x 2 layers, last 2 steps), one segment per query so one optimizer step per query (15,000 steps, batch 64), softmax cross entropy, weight decay 0.1 on every parameter, AdamATan2 lr 3e-4 (betas 0.9/0.95), warmup 2000, EMA 0.999. URM's own: one 352-d prefix puzzle embedding per version, SignSGD lr 1e-2, wd 0.1; no demonstrations in context.
